attributes.content:
**EL-HAZ-1.3 Front turn lamps follow the requests**

FLCM_Lighting shall light Lamp_FrontLeftTurn while LeftTurnLightRequest is 1 and Lamp_FrontRightTurn while RightTurnLightRequest is 1, as received in each TurnLightControl frame.

It shall add no flashing, filtering or timing of its own.

description: Allocated to building block FrontLighting. Flashing is generated once, in LightingControl; lamp modules only follow. That is what keeps all lamps in phase without any synchronisation between the lamp modules.
